reference: After cleaning mussels, place in baking dish and add garlic and sprinkle with parsley, black pepper, salt, oregano, bread crumbs and paprika. Cover bottom of baking dish with chicken broth and bake at 350° for 10 minutes.

title: Sauteed Mushrooms
ingredients: 2 Tb butter 1 Tb oil 1/2 lb fresh mushrooms, washed, well dried, left whole if small, sliced or quartered if large Optional: 1 to 2 Tb minced shallots or green onions Salt and pepper A 10-inch enameled skillet
reference: Place the skillet over high heat with the butter and oil. As soon as you see that the butter foam has begun to subside, indicating it is hot enough, add the mushrooms. Toss and shake the pan for 4 to 5 minutes. During their saute the mushrooms will at first absorb the fat. In 2 to 3 minutes the fat will reappear on their surface, and the mushrooms will begin to brown. As soon as they have browned lightly, remove from heat. Toss the shallots or green onions with the mushrooms. Saute over moderate heat for 2 minutes. Sauteed mushrooms may be cooked in advance, set aside, then reheated when needed. Season to taste just before serving.

Remove from the heat and stir in the shallots and onions. Stir in the mushrooms and cook for another 5 minutes, or until the mushrooms are tender. Serve immediately.

title: Tea Cakes
ingredients: 3/4 c. shortening 2 c. sugar 2 eggs 4 Tbsp. milk 1 tsp. vanilla 1 tsp. baking powder dash of nutmeg pinch of salt

prediction: Combine shortening, sugar, eggs, milk, vanilla, baking powder and nutmeg. Mix well. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 1 hour.

title: Chicken & Broccoli Casserole
ingredients: 3 boneless chicken breasts, cut into bite sized portions 20 ounces broccoli stems (sounds like a lot but it's not) 2 (10 1/2 ounce) cans cream of chicken soup 1 cup plain yogurt or 1 cup sour cream 1 teaspoon lemon juice (you can also use lime) 12 teaspoon curry powder 13 cup orange juice 2 -4 garlic cloves 12 cup breadcrumbs 1 tablespoon butter, melted 12 cup shredded cheddar cheese (I use extra sharp)

Place broccoli on the bottom of the baking dish. Then put the chicken on top and pour on the sauce. Top first with shredded cheese and then sprinkle bread crumbs on top. In a large bowl, combine chicken, broccoli, soup, yogurt, sour cream, lemon juice, curry powder, orange juice, garlic, bread crumbs, butter, and cheese. Pour into a greased 9x13 baking dish. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean.

prediction: Brown steak. Add onion, mushrooms, soup, water and sour cream. Mix well. Pour into greased and floured 9 x 13-inch pan. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

reference: Wash and peel potatoes. Place in 2 quart covered casserole. Add water; cover. Microwave on high 8 to 10 minutes. Drain; let cool. Dice potatoes. Drizzle with melted butter, sprinkle crumbled cheese on top and put in a 350* oven for 20-30 minutes or until cheese is melted. Tip: Cream cheese can be substituted for soft Brie cheese and shredded Cheddar cheese for the crumbled Blue cheese for a diffent "cheesy casserole".
prediction: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 9x13 baking dish. In a large bowl, combine potatoes, water, brie, yogurt, eggs, salt, and pepper. Mix well. Pour into prepared dish. Bake for 20 minutes, or until lightly browned.

prediction: Saute onion and beef in butter until tender. Add bread crumb mixture, tomato juice, salt and pepper. Mix well. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Baked Squash From The Black-Eyed Pea

title: Chicken Salad with Tahini-Yogurt Dressing

reference: In a medium bowl, whisk the yogurt, lime juice, garlic, tahini, turmeric and 1 tablespoon of olive oil. Fold in the cucumber and mint and season with salt and pepper. prediction: Combine pineapple, sugar, flour, crackers and margarine. Mix well. Pour into 9 x 13-inch casserole dish. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Homemade Ricotta Cheese Recipe
ingredients: 8 cups (half gallon) pasteurized whole milk (not ultrapasteurized) 1/2 cup heavy cream 1 teaspoon fine salt 1/4 cup distilled white vinegar
reference: Line a large fine-mesh strainer with a double layer of ultrafine woven cheesecloth and place over a large nonreactive bowl; set aside. Place milk, cream, and salt in a large saucepan, set over medium heat, and heat until mixture reaches between 175 degrees F and 180 degrees F on an instant-read thermometer, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and drizzle in vinegar while slowly and gently stirring. Stop stirring as soon as all of the vinegar has been added. Let mixture sit undisturbed while the milk solids coagulate and float to the surface, leaving the whey underneath, about 20 minutes. Gently ladle the solids into the strainer, leaving as much whey in the saucepan as possible; discard the whey. Let the ricotta drain, without pressing down on the curds, until most of the liquid has drained, about 1 hour. Remove the ricotta from the cheesecloth and store in a covered container in the refrigerator for up to 1 week.
prediction: In a large saucepan, combine the milk, cream, salt, and vinegar. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes. Remove from heat and stir in the Ricotta cheese. Serve immediately.

title: Pumpkin Cheesecake - Low Carb
ingredients: 6 -8 ounces pecans (or favorite nut) 2 tablespoons Splenda granular, sugar substitute 5 tablespoons butter, melted 32 ounces cream cheese (room temp, 4-8oz packages) 1 cup Splenda granular, sugar substitute 12 teaspoon cinnamon 14 teaspoon ground ginger 15 ounces solid-pack pumpkin 3 eggs 1 tablespoon vanilla nonstick cooking spray

Cool on wire rack to room temperature, cover and refrigerate 2 hours before serving.

title: Chicken Breast with Crispy and Creamy Cheese Coating

title: Sour Cream Cutout Cookies

title: Kiwi Creme Brulee
ingredients: 1 large egg 4 large egg yolks 1/2 cup sugar plus 1/2 tablespoon for each serving 3 cups heavy cream 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract 2 kiwis finely chopped, brown fuzzy peel removed
reference: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees F. In a mixing bowl, add the egg, egg yolks, and 1/2 cup of the sugar and beat together on low speed until just combined. Heat the cream in a small pot until it's very hot to the touch but not boiling. With the mixer on low speed, slowly add the cream to the eggs. I found using a ladle worked really well to add small amounts at a time. Then, add the vanilla and chopped Kiwi and ladle into 6 to 8 ramekins until almost full. Place the ramekins in a baking pan and carefully pour boiling water into the pan to come halfway up the sides of the ramekins. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes, until the custards are set when gently shaken. Remove the custards from the water bath, cool to room temperature, and refrigerate until firm. When ready to serve, set your oven to Broil and place the rack all the way to the top. Sprinkle 1/2 tablespoon of sugar evenly over the Custard and place evenly on a baking sheet. Broil for 2-3 minutes and watch closely! It can burn really quickly. Allow to sit at room temperature for a minute or two until the caramelized sugar hardens.
prediction: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. In a large bowl, combine egg yolk, sugar, and vanilla. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form. Cool completely on a wire rack.

title: Dark Chocolate Ganache

title: Tortilla Torte Recipe
ingredients: 1 package (12 ounces) semisweet chocolate pieces 4 cups (32 ounces) sour cream, divided 10 (7-inch) flour tortillas 3/4 cup (about 6 ounces) confectioners' sugar, sifted chocolate curls or sprinkles, for garnish (optional)

prediction: Cut spinach into 1/2-inch cubes. Drain well. Add strawberries and almonds. Mix well. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch baking dish. Sprinkle with almonds. Bake at 350° for 30 minutes.

title: Broccoli And Angel Hair Pasta Recipe
ingredients: 1 lrg broccoli head 1 lb Angel hair pasta 1 x Garlic elephant head 1/2 c. Margarine or possibly butter Extra virgin olive oil Crushed red pepper Parmesan cheese White pepper
reference: Cut broccoli into small pcs. Chop elephant head garlic into small pcs. Place broccoli in a microwave safe container. Add in about 1/4 c. water. Cover lightly with plastic wrap.
